description: Roughly two months remain before the primary election, with early voting starting on July 7 and Election Day arriving on July 19. Who are the candidates on this year’s ballot? The Voice asked each of them to submit a short bio to share their respective backgrounds and priorities.
title: Delegate Heather Bagnall - Meet The Candidate - Severna Park Voice — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
